# tool-use-eval

> Score function-calling outputs against expected calls: schema checks, acceptable-value sets per argument, order-insensitive parallel calls and per-failure-code summaries. Python package `trysac-tool-use-eval`, import name `tool_use_eval`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
